assumption_high_confidence: Calculation based on actual smart meter data
assumption_medium_confidence: Hour split estimated from home profile — not based on smart meter data
assumption_low_confidence: Low confidence — only fixed plans shown; upload a smart meter file or specify at least two clear usage signals for a full recommendation
assumption_default_kwh: Average annual consumption of {{kwh}} kWh used as the calculation basis
assumption_taoz_data: TAOZ baseline cost calculated from billing period data only — slight deviation from the annual average possible due to seasonal variation
assumption_weekend_window: Plans covering weekends were estimated assuming Fri–Sat consumption proportional to total matches other days of the week
ineligibility_low_confidence: Smart meter or two clear usage signals required to recommend a time-of-use tariff
ineligibility_requires_smart_meter: This tariff requires a smart meter
ineligibility_coverage_area: This tariff is not available in your area
